## Summary

**`benchmarkSet` exists hermetically — `LEDGER.md` flips
`PENDING_CREATE` → `benchset.stage3.v1`.**
`crates/hh-bench/fixtures/benchset/stage3_v1` carries four strata — A
(`suite.tb2`, `coding_terminal`, `fresh_temporal`), C (`suite.swebench`,
`contaminated_public`, retired for headline), D (`suite.taubench`,
`structured_tool`), E (`suite.agentdojo`, `adversarial_security`) — each
with recorded `model_io`, recorded original-runner verdicts (≥ 3 original
runs per parity-subset task), canonical suite/task JSON, split hashes and
split-assignment records, and fixture adapters with deterministic
graders. `hh_bench::benchset` loads strictly and refuses unknown
members/wrong ids/incomplete corpora. The §10.7 legs deferred to the set
run over it in `crates/hh-bench/tests/s3_12b.rs`: the T-LCD-03 stratum-C
round-trip at n = 5 through the canonical `hh-control` Driver + replay
path, the A/C/D/E adapter-parity legs through the corpus's own adapters
(materialize/expose/collect/grade — never self-mocks), and the
unbudgeted-arm parity refusal. A *live* foreign-manifest import stays a
named residual — foreign toolchains are outside the gate's authorized
scope.

**Both exemplars produce real `ComparisonReport{budget_match.status}` —
the records-in path, not a re-stated fixture.** In
`crates/hh-embed/tests/s3_12b.rs`, `lab/compaction-family-v1` (30 plans)
and `lab/control-strategy-family-v1` (50 plans incl. the `iso_cost`
companion) schedule/launch/settle through the real `ExperimentEngine`
over a real `Store` + `LabDocs`; the accepted subject runs honestly
record `control.budget.consumed` on every declared matched dim, then
project `project_row` → `eval_run` → `hh_analysis::analyze` →
`hh_eval::compare` — the same path `lab.eval.compare` serves
records-in. Both produced reports read `budget_match.status = matched`
(the runs' recorded medians are equal on every matched dimension, honestly
recorded — never asserted). The `steerable-a` × `steerable-a-iso`
cross-mode compare refuses `IncommensurableMatch`: ADR-0213's interim
OQ-363 rule is exercised, and it **stands for Reading 2** (recorded in
the run ledger — no amendment needed).

**The retirement chain is engine-driven, end to end.** A `retirement`
`ExperimentSpec` settles 30 plans through the engine; the settled rows
project and compare through `hh_eval::compare`; `removal_verdict` reads
the produced `CompareOutcome` (`Pass` inside the pre-registered margin);
`settle_removal_test` yields `RetirementEligible`; a human-sealed
`retire` emits `expired → retired` with the produced report as evidence.
No verdict is fed in — Reading 1's caveat is discharged.

**The hosting-absent run is recorded and repeatable.** `cargo test
--workspace --exclude hh-hosting` runs the native suite with the hosting
tier physically absent — the command and result are committed in
`docs/build/runs/S3.12b.md` beside `scripts/check-removability.sh`'s
structural edge-freedom arm (AC-R-2.10.6-5 / AC-R-2.11.4-12 /
AC-R-2.12.2-12 absent⇒unchanged halves).

**The DEFERRALS sweep is honest, never flattering.** The five
verify-and-flip candidates each retain genuinely unmet cells (Stage-4
check-8, runtime metric emission, per-image canary channels, sink
fixtures, the combined fault fixture) — all stay `OPEN` with dated
dispositions naming exactly what landed. Eleven residual rows carry
appended notes; five foreign-toolchain rows are carried forward to
GATE-ACCEPT per the GATE-G1 precedent; the DF-S1.9-4 audit ran (29/74
ADRs carry the ADR-0024 rung statement — the ADR-0240–0268 band; the
43-record gap is DF-S3.12b-2). **No Stage-3-scoped row is bare `OPEN`.**

**A real defect was found and carried, not hidden.** Honestly measuring
every matched dim makes `ExperimentEngine::close`'s E-4 recheck members
exceed `AUDIT_FIELD_MAX_BYTES` (512) under `OPEN_AUDIT` — the prior
engine test only recorded `model_calls`, so the cap never bound. The
tests assert the overrun; the fix (smaller members / `content_refs` /
re-bound class) is DF-S3.12b-1's owner (ADR-0291 D4).

**G2-5 documented, not resolved:** §9.4's broader Stage-3 gating list vs
§10.7's cited row (incl. AC-R-2.10.4-{3,6,7,11}, AC-R-2.5.3-7 deferred at
S3.9, and §10.7's mixed "3–4" staging of KA-3/-6/-7/-11) is recorded in
the run ledger for the operator's Reading-2 ruling.

GATE-G2 stays **PENDING** — this ticket closes the machine-achievable
cells; the operator re-reads the evidence at Reading 2.
